transcript:
DAVID (CONT’D): What? What did you say? 

[SFX: We hear a faint grumble. The sound of a dying woman - Judith -  trying to talk and only managing a faint guttural moan. Very difficult to decipher.]

DAVID (CONT’D): Please... Just say it...

David’s voice is now so faint, that you really have to struggle to hear.

DAVID (CONT’D): Why don’t you just close your eyes? Here... I'll help you...

[SFX: The grumble gets more pained, as he wraps his hands around Judith’s throat. We only know this because the gutteral moan starts to sound gasping for breath.]

DAVID (CONT’D) (Straining under the act and sobbing): Shhhhh... Go to sleep... Please, just go to sleep...

The voices are so distant now. So distant. Those with acute hearing would hear Judith’s last words.

JUDITH: You can never leave.

[SFX: She then attacks him. But the sound by now is almost indecipherable.]

[SFX - LOUD - VERY LOUD - An old telephone, the same one that we heard at the very beginning, rings. Cutting through the silence like a sledgehammer. Because of the sound getting quieter and quieter before, this is our big jump scare moment.]
